recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to individual identifier-system records or their display belong in THO/UTG; FHIR core only needs follow-up if a later work-group decision changes the retained guidance page or its TSMG policy relationship.
issue_request: FHIR-35932 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to remove the core Known Identifier Systems registry table after its identifier-system records were migrated to HL7 Terminology, and to replace the page text with guidance that HL7 Terminology curates Identifier systems, that pre-release THO URIs are mandatory for the relevant FHIR release, and that unlisted shared identifiers follow the HL7 terminology authority process.
initial_application: The source change was applied by f40fc710c34b0106cdc391d3ef696f746e83749c, which removed the old source/identifier-registry.html table and <%identifierlist%> include and added the THO/UTG migration guidance. Later commit 71f5602acf06ad7fe0f46052ca1c6b477311c1ae updated the former HTA reference to the current TSMG policy link while preserving the migration.
additional_context: UP-285 implemented the THO/UTG side by creating identifier-system records from the former FHIR registry and adding them to the THO identifier rendering manifest. FHIR-I minutes record the 22-0-0 FHIR-35932 vote, and Terminology Authority minutes discuss identifier-system policy and THO as the single source of truth. The page remains in current build/navigation scope as a guidance page, and adjacent issues FHIR-37494, FHIR-42959, and FHIR-35933 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/identifier-registry.html no longer contains the old registry table or stale registration instructions, links to terminology.hl7.org/identifiers.html, and contains the accepted SHOULD/SHALL conformance language plus later TSMG policy guidance.
